mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scm_supplier_qualification (qualification_id, tenant_id, supplier_id, qualification_type, qualification_no, issued_by, valid_from, valid_until, status, remark, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{qualificationId}, #{tenantId}, #{supplierId}, #{qualificationType}, #{qualificationNo}, #{issuedBy}, #{validFrom}, #{validUntil}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM scm_supplier_qualification WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND supplier_id = #{supplierId}
mapper.select: SELECT qualification_id, tenant_id, supplier_id, qualification_type, qualification_no, issued_by, valid_from, valid_until, status, remark, created_at, updated_at FROM scm_supplier_qualification WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND supplier_id = #{supplierId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
